name: AVR128DA48 Curiosity Nano (DM164151)
description: 5 V-capable AVR128DA48 (24 MHz, 128 KB flash) on a small breadboard-friendly board with a built-in nEDBG UPDI debugger and virtual COM port; great for modern AVR work.
notes: The AVR DA itself runs from 1.8-5.5 V and has 5 V-tolerant IO, but the board's target rail is 3.3 V by default (adjustable). Programmed over UPDI by the on-board debugger; also works with Arduino (DxCore) and PlatformIO.
Microchip's page was not fetchable, so price is DigiKey's $10.61 (Mouser's older $24 listing looks stale). Board size and GPIO count are estimates.
